notes: Molenwerf 1 (BAG pand 0363100012066028, built 1980, 2686 m2 footprint in several wings, roof max 32.4 m) is the 1980 office campus on the north side of the Haarlemmerweg at the corridor's west end. Photographed front-on: the north wing in 2019-11-07 (TMX7316060226-000470_pano_0000_001812, 32.5 m wall at 12.1 m, 9.9 deg obliquity, 4 % foliage), the east wing in 2019-11-07 (..._0000_001764), the two-storey glazed podium under the tall south wing in 2022-03-29 (TMX7316010203-002491_pano_0004_000010, 19.9 m at 28.1 m, 1.5 deg) and the west wing in 2025-07-01 (recording_2025-07-01_09-03-48_01355).

2026-10-21 correction (this lane): three surfaces were taken out of the groups because 3DBAG merges them, coplanar, into a big panel and the group then draws them at the big panel's height. Surface 205 is a 5.1 x 4.1 m annex wall coplanar with the 27.4 m north wing wall (surface 121) and surface 100 a 0.2 x 4.1 m sliver on the east wall: both were drawn as 19.5 m of windows over a 4 m annex, which is what the eaves-vs-3dbag gate caught (model 19.47 vs 3dbag 4.02). Surface 109 (0.4 x 1.5 m) merged into the tall wing's east panel the same way (model 29.73 vs 3dbag 19.40). They now fall to otherWalls (blank), which is what they are: plain low annex walls.

The two-storey glazed podium (surfaces 98, 132: panel 95, 19.9 m, eaves 4.1 m, reaching 13.3 m over part of its width) is now walls[2], 5 bays, one tall storey, entrance. It was the largest blank wall of the audit (204 m2 facing south) and the shopfront the south photo shows at the foot of the tall wing. Its paired crop covers 19.9 m of wall including the taller wing rising behind it, so the mask IoU stays 0.398 (WARN, reason written).

Likeness 2026-10-21: walls[0] PASS (wall #4b4039 vs #5f4f45, dL 0.063; glazing 0.431 vs 0.399; columns 5 vs 6; IoU 0.657), walls[2] WARN (dL -0.014; glazing 0.334 vs 0.256; IoU 0.398). walls[1] (the plain taller wing, panels 86/143/151/160/206) has NO paired photo: the podium edge, not the wing, is the BAG outline edge that all-walls.ts rectifies, so every archived crop of this pand matches a podium or banded-wing panel; the wing's own south face stands 1.9 m behind the outline and no crop covers it.

The taller wing and the podium take #7c675b, the south crop's daylight value.
